findings.what: Public booking Server Action has no rate limiting although the PRD surfaces table requires /book to be rate-limited; slot-flooding abuse is possible

Server-side booking validation (isValidSlot) ignores the current time, so a direct call to submitBookingAction can book a past slot; only the client calendar blocks past dates. Booking `date` field is validated but never cross-checked against startTime
getAuth() (needs DATABASE_URL) is evaluated before await headers(), so bare `npm run build` fails prerendering /staff/reception; succeeds only with DB env set
Sweep only matches reminderAt within ±5 min of now; a cron outage >10 min or a booking/reschedule made <24h ahead means the reminder is silently never sent
isUniqueViolation and REMINDER_LEAD_MS/SLOT_MS duplicated from booking.ts
Walk-in/phone staff bookings send the patient no confirmation email or manage links
Schedule-X resource view not used; custom grid substituted
Every booking inserts a new patient row; no patient de-duplication
Only primary/accent brand tokens set; remaining palette is default shadcn neutral and README still describes the default Geist font setup, so §8.3 anti-generic ceiling only partly met
